fixed_graph_joint_legality.statement: For recolourings of disjoint colour classes on one fixed graph, if the base state and each singleton switch state are rainbow C7, then their joint state is rainbow C7.
fixed_graph_joint_legality.reason: Any non-rainbow joint C7 repeats one named colour; that colour's same edge pair already occurs in its singleton state, or in the base state for an untouched colour.

symmetric_no_deletion_search.model: n16; add all w-X and u-X; forbid cw,cu,wz,uz; choose seven of fifteen other incident edges; no old deletion

symmetric_one_exchange_search.model: same symmetric model; choose eight optional edges and delete one admissible old edge

general_one_exchange_search.model: require wx1 and ux2; forbid cw,cu,wz,uz,wy1,uy2; choose fourteen of nineteen other new edges and delete one admissible old edge
general_one_exchange_search.completeness: complete for this natural-switch, one-old-edge-exchange model

conditional_output_rank.statement: If different demands receive legal arcs to distinct new outputs f,g outside the old K(4,2) neighbourhood, matching rank rises from two to four and its maximum deficiency becomes zero.

classification.next_unsearched_scope: at least two old-edge deletions with seventeen replacements, a non-natural switch, or a different extension outside the displayed model
